technique_name: Describe what a scientific research article should have.
description: A scientific research article should include a title, an abstract, an introduction, a method section, a results section, a discussion section, and a conclusion. The title should be clear and informative, summarizing the main point of the research. The abstract should provide a brief description of the study, the main findings, and its implications.
